notes: מֵאֵין is split: the מִן is unrepresented (rule 40) and אַיִן carries 'There is none' headed on the negation (rule 50).
The two predicates divide as rule 20 requires — אַתָּה takes only 'thou' while גָּדוֹל takes 'art great', and the second, gapped line's copula joins its predicate under rule 34.
